source_note: Entries preserve terminal outcomes returned by the fifteen independent READ_ONLY_AUDIT/architecture chats. They are audit inputs, not canonical/scientific truth. Blocking claims used for a gate must be revalidated against the integrated subject head.

findings.summary: Valid archive/checkpoint integrity is not authenticated history/provenance; causes are references rather than verified causality.
Provider budgets are cooperative accounting rather than a hard resource sandbox.
Provider cancellation and stale-result rejection semantics are not yet defined.
P2 unhex lacks a pre-decode input-size ceiling.
P4 schedule and aggregate replay work need stronger admission/resource bounds before hostile-input exposure.

gate_impact: Advisory to G0A; blocking if archive/checkpoint trust is placed in the minimum public slice
Hardening input for G0B/G1 provider exposure

findings.summary: Future runtime must separate canonical truth from execution; pin temporal context at admission; use immutable provider catalog, atomic resource admission, stale-result generations, non-authoritative caches and full quiescence on close.
P4 logical replay/checkpoint/archive integrity is strong, but WAL/fsync/atomic root publication/crash recovery/durable backend SPI/migration/exclusive-writer durability do not exist.

gate_impact: Persistence implementation remains behind G2; durable proof required before G3

findings.summary: Current descriptor/registry semantics are useful but JS binding is not a public ABI; future provider boundary should use opaque handles/bounded messages and keep TRANSITION proposal-only under host/P4 authority.

gate_impact: Research input only; no provider ABI implementation authorization

findings.summary: Unreal must project stable C-ABI canonical IDs onto UObject/Actor state, never derive canonical identity from engine objects; explicit thread/buffer/lifecycle/stale-work rules are required.

gate_impact: Adapter remains blocked by G3_PROVIDER_AND_DURABILITY_PROOF plus G-TARGET-CABI-STABLE

findings.summary: Strict single-thread embedded WASM is viable in principle; external wasm fetch is incompatible with strict single-file/direct-file baseline; threaded/shared-memory WASM is Enhanced-only.

gate_impact: No implementation authorization; future WASM remains behind platform/runtime gates

findings.summary: R6 scientificStateHash indirectly depends on floating/libm model-derived values; cross-runtime byte-identical evidence is missing.
Unicode NFC boundary retains a portability/determinism evidence gap.
localeCompare LRU tie-break is latent host/locale dependence under a currently dead invariant.

gate_impact: Scientific/public fingerprint promotion must not treat current R6 scientific hash as canonical without closing evidence gap

findings.summary: Substring authority matching can accept hostile labels such as NOT_CANONICAL/NOT_SOURCE_BACKED.
Spoofed authority/evidence labels can reach authoritative/exact presentation structure.
Nested cross-scale representation authority is insufficiently typed/validated.
R6 authority projection loses distinctions including DERIVED, MODEL_DERIVED_SIMULATION, MEASURED_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE and UNSUPPORTED.

integration_patch_requests: AUTH-001 strict closed authority/evidence validation plus adversarial matrix
AUTH-002 typed nested cross-scale representation authority
gate_impact: Blocks scientific/public authority promotion until repaired or isolated behind strict projection

findings.summary: Scientific model-version lineage is stale: declared causal-1 while runtime producer is causal-2.
Provenance, assumptions/applicability, limitations and uncertainty semantics are dropped at environmentState projection.
Conservation is not fail-closed; conserved:false evidence can still be hashed/presented.
Dedicated causal test is outside the Wave-0 CI gate.

gate_impact: Blocks new scientific authority promotion; input to PROD-W1-SCI-FP

findings.summary: P4 checkpoint/archive verification establishes integrity/self-consistency but does not fully establish authenticated or semantically trusted imported state; coherently rehashed malformed state can evade the intended trust claim.
Provider resource accounting/cancellation is cooperative and not a hostile-code sandbox.
Budget separation and pre-hash resource admission need stronger evidence before ABI/network-facing exposure.

gate_impact: SEC-01 blocks G0A if checkpoint/archive are included in the minimum normative/public seam

findings.summary: Observed stage transition p50 about 1.351s, p95 about 1.855s, worst about 1.859s; render/update tails remain bounded in the audited campaign.
Campaign-wide max can underreport stage worst; p99 CPU, cancellation, serialization/persistence/host timing and physical GPU remain incomplete.
50-loop soak remained bounded but heap increased about 3.77 MB (8.30%).

gate_impact: No current Wave-0 gate blocker; resource/cancellation evidence debt propagates to later runtime/release gates

findings.summary: No current portability blocker found across tested Linux/Windows/macOS and x64/ARM64 matrices.
Current WASM experiment is not Core proof.
Native portability evidence remains future G1 debt.

gate_impact: No G0A/G0B block from current JS/P2/P4 portability
Native/WASM gates still require future evidence

findings.summary: No C ABI exists in the audited R6; allocator/layout/thread/error/version compatibility claims are therefore unsupported rather than failed.

gate_impact: Future C ABI evidence required before G-TARGET-CABI-STABLE; no current ABI to certify

findings.summary: No durable WAL/fsync/atomic committed-root/recovery backend exists.
A stale-but-valid archive/committed image can represent rollback that integrity alone cannot detect.
Checkpoint self-consistency does not establish historical provenance.
Power-loss/torn-write/fsync/interrupted-compaction fault campaign is not implemented.
No Wave-0 product regression found; single-file/offline, canonical identity/history, picking, continuity, accessibility and bounded-resource journeys passed on audited evidence.
open-visual-evidence target selection is timing-sensitive (GALAXY versus SYSTEM) because target can be read before progressive macro commit.
Portrait/mobile information density and truncation remain pre-existing baseline debt; physical GPU evidence remains external.

gate_impact: No blocker to repair batch; future founder-visible/product/release evidence must retain these debts

current_g0a_blocker: SEC-01 if checkpoint/archive remain in minimum normative/public slice
product_gate_blocker: PROD-W1-CONTRACTS lacks required v4 execution-state and immutable terminal-handoff artifacts
